tool_input.description: Quick check of MessageFormat number formatting behavior
Remove scratch dir and rerun the agent test
Remove scratch directory used for manual checks
Delete individual scratch files then remove the now-empty scratch directory

result:
Created `src/test/org/apache/commons/lang/text/ExtendedMessageFormatAgentTest.java` with 21 self-contained JUnit 3.8-style test methods (matching this project's existing `TestCase` style), covering:

- Happy-path formatting with/without a registry, locale handling, and `toPattern()` round-tripping
- Custom `FormatFactory` registration, mixing custom and standard MessageFormat types, and format-name fallback
- Quoting edge cases (escaped `''`, quoted literal braces, a lone unterminated quote's lenient behavior)
- Error cases: unterminated format element, invalid/non-numeric argument index, unterminated format description, and bad patterns with no registry
- The four disabled mutator methods (`setFormat*`) all throwing `UnsupportedOperationException`
- Reapplying a pattern on the same instance, and inherited `parse()` behavior

Note: one small side effect I couldn't fully clean up — while investigating actual runtime behavior (to avoid asserting incorrect exception messages), I created a scratch directory `_scratch_check` outside the test file to compile/run throwaway probes against the library; I removed its file contents, but the sandbox blocked removing the now-empty directory itself (flagged as a "workspace directory" deletion). You may want to `rmdir _scratch_check` yourself.

All tests pass via `./_tools/test.sh` (21/21), both in isolation and as part of the full suite.
